## 2) Why the candidate could have shown “PASS” previously
If your gating logic allows a “PASS” based on *minimum* constraints (e.g., lockbox_min above threshold) without sufficiently penalizing:
- large drop in lockbox_mean, and/or
- worse worst_mdd,
then it can pass a constraint-based filter but still be non-competitive against the champion.

If you want, I can help you tighten the select-best criteria (e.g., require candidate lockbox_mean >= champion * X, and worst_mdd not worse than champion by more than Y).
